name: Analyze sales data in a Daytona sandbox and post a weekly report to Slack
description: Every Monday, downloads a sales CSV, uploads it into a Daytona sandbox and lets an AI agent analyze it with Python: revenue, cities, product lines, payment methods and the monthly trend. The agent's report is posted to a Slack channel and the sandbox is deleted.
shortDescription: Analyze a sales CSV with Python in a Daytona sandbox and post the AI-written report to Slack.
keyFeatures: Daytona sandbox created per run, the CSV uploaded into it, and the sandbox deleted afterwards
AI agent that analyzes the data with pandas in the sandbox, with every number computed by code
Tool Sandbox ID pinned to the run's sandbox, so only the code comes from the model
Report formatted for Slack and posted to a channel
prerequisites: Daytona account and API key with the write:sandboxes and delete:sandboxes permissions
Slack connection and the channel to post the report to (replace your-channel-id in Post the report to Slack)
A sales CSV reachable over HTTP; the template uses a public sample, and the agent's system prompt lists its columns
idealFor: Sales and operations teams that want a weekly, data-backed sales summary in Slack without building a reporting pipeline.
steps: Upload the CSV into the sandbox.
The sales analyst agent analyzes the file with Python in that sandbox and writes the report.
Post the report to a Slack channel.
